verdict.rationale: SavvyCal documents a REST API with JSON, OAuth 2.0 and personal access tokens, plus webhooks. An agent could call these as a custom tool surface, but only through user-built wrapping. There is no MCP server or agent-specific tool layer in the evidence. Probes found no llms.txt and no published OpenAPI spec, which would ease automatic tool generation. Missing for 10: an official MCP server or agent tool-calling surface, documented API endpoints for availability, bookings and event types, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec or llms.txt, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent use.
